emotion: Appetizing, fast, approachable, and localized for the Urdaneta community

headings.description: Bold, friendly, and highly legible for restaurant names, promotions, and section titles. Never use generic fonts for headers.

body.description: Clean geometric sans-serif for menus, pricing, and descriptions to ensure readability in low-bandwidth or outdoor mobile usage.

rules: Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body text.

primary.description: Vibrant Tangerine. Used for primary CTAs (Order Now, Checkout) and active states. Evokes appetite and speed.

secondary.description: Sunshine Yellow. Used for ratings, highlights, and secondary actions.

pabili_accent.description: Ocean Blue. Used specifically for the 'Pabili' (grocery/errand) service to visually separate it from food delivery.

background.description: Off-white background to make white cards and food photos pop.

rules: Never use pure black or pure gray. Grays must have a slight tint.
Primary color MUST be used sparingly. Only for CTAs, active states, and primary icons.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text.

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons and pills. Creates a friendly, consumable feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse shadows (shadow-sm or shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]). Do not use heavy borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/80 and a delicate border-white/20 for sticky headers and bottom mobile navigation.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) on hero banners to kill digital flatness.

customer_app.container: max-w-md mx-auto sm:max-w-full (Mobile app feel on PC).
customer_app.navigation: Sticky bottom tab bar for mobile. Top navbar for PC.
customer_app.home_feed: Bento-style promotional grid at the top. Horizontal scroll groups (flex overflow-x-auto snap-x) for food categories, followed by a vertical list of restaurants.
customer_app.spacing: Generous vertical spacing (gap-6 to gap-8) between sections.

dashboards.container: Full width with sidebar (Restaurant / Admin / Driver PC).
dashboards.grid: High density bento grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6 for metrics and analytics.

motion.hover: Cards lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow deepens on hover.
motion.click: Scale down slightly (scale-95) for buttons to give tactile feedback.
motion.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-out for layout shifts, transition-colors for buttons.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for restaurant lists and dashboard widgets.

accessibility.contrast: Text over food images MUST have a dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent) to ensure readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button').

images.description: Grilled meat street food. Use for prominent local food promotions or hero section.
Skewers of food on a blue tray. Use for local Urdaneta vendor placeholders.
Person serving food from a bowl. Good for 'Home Cooked' or 'Soups' categories.
Delivery person with scooter on city street. Use for Driver app landing page or rider profile placeholder.
Delivery rider checking smartphone on motorcycle. Use for 'Tracking' view or Driver Dashboard.

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Use font-bold and tracking-wide. Add subtle scale-down on active.
component_rules.cards: Highly rounded (rounded-2xl). Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no heavy shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-lg and -translate-y-1.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to rounded-xl with bg-white/50 and border-border/60. Focus ring is primary color.
component_rules.badges: Used heavily for 'Free Delivery', 'Promo', 'New'. rounded-full, small text, high contrast (e.g., bg-yellow-400 text-black).
component_rules.toasts: Use 'sonner' for order updates and pabili request confirmations.
component_rules.icons: Use lucide-react (default). For highly detailed illustrations, use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a hybrid fullstack app tailored for Urdaneta City, Philippines.
Prioritize a mobile-first layout. On large screens (PC), the customer view should act as a centered mobile-width container or elegantly expand using a bento grid.
Distinctly separate the 'Food Delivery' flow from the 'Pabili (Grocery/Errand)' flow. Use the pabili_accent color for the Pabili flow to create a mental model shift.
For the Driver, Restaurant, and Admin views, switch to a dense, functional dashboard layout (sidebar + metrics grid).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, headers overlaying content, or bottom navs without adding backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent base color (e.g., bg-white/80).
Use standard JS files for React components (not TSX as per project constraints).
All functional interactions MUST be testable. Add data-testid attributes to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and actionable cards.
Do NOT use arbitrary AI emojis (like 🤖, 🔮, 💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Implement clear location context. Visually anchor the user in 'Urdaneta City' on the home page header.
Add 'GCash' and 'PayMaya' as custom payment options alongside COD in the checkout UI.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
NEVER apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
NEVER center align the app container in CSS (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
